editorial.blurb: Penelopes is a fully vegan taqueria that proves plant-based Mexican food can be spectacular, with inventive meat alternatives and a menu so beloved that regulars return constantly.
editorial.insiderTip: Skip the Asada if you visit — reviewers consistently note it's tough and underwhelming — and instead order the Soy Chorizo, which earned praise as 'the best,' or try the pozole, chilaquiles, or carne asada fries that keep regulars coming back.
